verified.note: Article 3 of the Koninklijk besluit van 24 juni 2003, served from Justel, the federal government's consolidated-legislation database. It is the binding definition of the ondernemingsnummer the VAT number is built from: “Het ondernemings- en het vestigingseenheidsnummer bevatten 10 cijfers… Z, het eerste cijfer, is 0 of 1”, which is the shape this record's format encodes, and it places the check in “het negende en het tiende cijfer”. It fixes the position of the check, not its arithmetic.

note.en: The Crossroads Bank exhausted the 0-series and now issues enterprise numbers beginning with 1. The two series differ only in that leading digit; the modulus 97 over the first eight digits is the same for both. A serial of zeros satisfies that modulus in either series, so both zero numbers are denied by name.
Electronic address for e-invoice routing: the EAS scheme code plus your identifier. Carry it now and the card is already correct when a counterparty moves to Peppol.
note.es: Dirección electrónica para el enrutamiento de facturas: el código de esquema EAS más tu identificador. Tenerlo ya deja la tarjeta lista cuando una contraparte pase a Peppol.

note.en: Structured B2B e-invoicing over Peppol since January 2026.
